nodes.summary: A family $F$ of subsets of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is union-free if there are no pairwise distinct $A, B, C \in F$ with $A \cup B = C$.
nodes.title: Union-free family

nodes.summary: For every real $\varepsilon > 0$ and all sufficiently large $n$, the maximum size of a union-free family of subsets of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is at most $(1 + \varepsilon)\binom{n}{\lfloor n/2 \rfloor}$; that is, it is at most $(1 + o(1))\binom{n}{\lfloor n/2 \rfloor}$.
nodes.title: Kleitman's bound for union-free families (Erdős Problem 447)

nodes.summary: The assertion that, for every real $\varepsilon > 0$ and all sufficiently large $n$, the maximum size of a union-free family of subsets of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is at most $(1 + \varepsilon)\binom{n}{\lfloor n/2 \rfloor}$; that is, it is at most $(1 + o(1))\binom{n}{\lfloor n/2 \rfloor}$.
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 447, second question

nodes.summary: The maximum size of a union-free family of subsets of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is $o(2^n)$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Union-free families have vanishing density (Erdős Problem 447)

nodes.summary: The assertion that the maximum size of a union-free family of subsets of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is $o(2^n)$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Erdős Problem 447, first question

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the largest size $|F|$ of a union-free family $F$ of subsets of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$.
nodes.title: Maximum size of a union-free family

nodes.summary: A family $F$ of finite sets is union-free over its subfamilies if no member $A \in F$ is the union of a nonempty subfamily of $F$ that does not contain $A$.
nodes.title: Families in which no member is a union of other members
